headline: You cannot delegate real work to agents you cannot hold to account.
lede: Accountability has two halves, and both scale the same way — from a single principal to an organization of them.

sibling.title: Ateles answers who was authorized
sibling.body: Initiative, delegation, and approval — governed execution for a single principal, then multi-operator ownership, scoped delegation and approval, distributed authority, and an organization that governs itself.

sibling.title: Neotoma answers what was true
sibling.body: The system of record for AI agents — deterministic state for a single writer, then for many, authority over what may be corrected, disagreement between principals represented rather than flattened, and governance an organization can read. Ateles acts against Neotoma state.

closing: Neither is sufficient alone. Authority without a record tells you who may act but not against what state. A record without authority tells you what happened but not whether it was permitted.
